::: mission-lead
Salem Custom Screen Printing is a small, faith-driven business creating custom apparel for individuals, churches, events, and youth camps.
:::

::: pull-quote
Every shirt we print carries more than ink — it carries a message.
:::

Whether it's a fundraiser, a camp tee, or a gift, we're here to help you share what matters most.

### Made with care

Every order is printed and packed with care in our small Chicago studio.
